description: This file defines the ChatPage React component that constitutes the main chat interface of a conversational chatbot platform. It manages message state, simulates assistant responses, and renders various child components like Header, ChatContainer, and ChatInput, with styling and auto-scrolling behavior.

methods.name: simulateAssistantResponse
methods.description: Simulates an assistant reply with a delay, currently returns a static message; designed to be replaced with real backend integration.

methods.name: handleSend
methods.description: Handles sending a user message, updates message state, and triggers the assistant response.
